title: workers/signaling: publish fan-out is O(N*K) and per-connection rate-limit resets across hibernation
description:
workers/signaling O(N*K) fan-out + rate-limit hibernation reset. DONE.

Fix (1) fan-out: DO now keeps an in-memory connId->WebSocket Map (rebuilt in rehydrate(), synced on accept/close/error); socketFor() is O(1) lookup instead of an O(N) getWebSockets()+deserializeAttachment scan per recipient (~200k deserializes/publish at caps).
Fix (2) rate-limit: TokenBucket state {tokens,last} is persisted into each socket's attachment on every publish and restored in rehydrate() via new SignalingRelay.bucketState()/restoreBucket() (+ TokenBucket.snapshot()/restore()). A drained bucket no longer resets to full burst on hibernation wake; it refills from the persisted timestamp.

Files: workers/signaling/src/{relay.ts,index.ts}, test/guards.test.ts (+4 tests), docs/37-collab.md.

Verify: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> exit 0 (all Done). workers/signaling: pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; pnpm test -> 52 passed (relay 23 + guards 29); wrangler deploy --dry-run builds worker OK (15.93 KiB, DO+Vars bindings intact).
